$comment: Every skill in ai_tooling/skills/ and the group it belongs to. setup.ps1 publishes from
this file, verify-agent-setup.ps1 checks it against the folders, and the skill
inventory in ai_tooling/documentation/overview.md is generated from it
A skill lives in ai_tooling/skills/{group}/{name}/SKILL.md. Its owner, source, apps and
default come from its group; a skill entry may override apps and default, and
carries its own status. A deprecated skill names its replacement (replacedBy) and
Groups: upstream/{stack} for skills an update-{stack}-skills.ps1 installer brings in,
custom for project skills every app can use, custom-{app} for one app's.
Profiles choose what one developer publishes: setup.ps1 -Profile core.
Two are built in: 'default' (every skill with default true) and 'all'.

upstream/mattpocock.description: Planning, grilling and engineering practice (Matt Pocock), configured through docs/agents/
upstream/mattpocock.$comment: mattpocock/skills, MIT (LICENSE in every skill folder). Stack-agnostic, so the blueprint ships it installed; remove the group and its skills when the project does not want it.
